items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: One fellow we had in the band, he was a terrific musician, Lamont Hamilton, tenor player.

ctx.x: Well, bringing up Charlie Parker, I mean, maybe you can give us your short speech on drugs and music. How prevalent was it when you were coming up?

Drugs was the thing then. I wasn't around Charlie Parker too much to see. Well, I mean, he was stupefied, you know, and I kept my distance from him because if it wasn't something that you could buy legal, I didn't want to be around it. One fellow we had in the band, he was a terrific musician, Lamont Hamilton, tenor player. He was a great musician. We was playing one time at the track as we call it, it's a boy ball room. Lamont played the first one of two nights and he got in with some women there and he'd come…
That's how we used to get on.
